## Service
Choose one: Spreadsheet dashboard/formulas / Web calculator / Presentation redesign / YouTube thumbnail / Other

## What do you need?
Describe the finished result you want in 1–3 sentences.

## Deliverable & quantity
What exactly should be delivered, and how many? Example: 1 Excel dashboard, 3 thumbnails, a 12-slide redesign, or 1 browser calculator.

## Goal
In one sentence, what should the finished work help you achieve?

## Requirements
List required features, formulas, dimensions, file formats, branding, platforms, or other specifications.

## Files / references
Attach current files, screenshots, examples, brand references, or sample data. If your data is private, replace it with anonymized/sample data before posting.

## Deadline
When do you need the finished work?

## Budget range
Optional. If you have a fixed maximum budget, include it here.

## Revision priority
If revisions are needed, what matters most: accuracy / design / speed / other?

## Must-not-change items
List any text, formulas, columns, branding, dimensions, or other details that must remain unchanged.

## Delivery / contact preference
How would you prefer to receive the finished files or continue the project discussion? Do not post private contact details unless you are comfortable making them public.

## What happens next
QuickForge will review the scope, clarify anything essential, and provide a price and delivery estimate before paid work begins.

> Do not post passwords, private keys, account credentials, payment details, IDs, or other sensitive information in this public issue.
